dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: It's cold and cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: Is it going to rain tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.arabic: مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْتَ؟ أَظُنُّ أَنَّهَا سَتُمْطِر.
dialogue.transliteration: maa ra2yuka anta? azunnu annahaa satumtir.
dialogue.english: What do you think? I think it will rain.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: إِذَنْ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَأْخُذِي مِظَلَّةً مَعَكِ.
dialogue.transliteration: idhan yajibu an ta2khudhee mizallatan ma3aki.
dialogue.english: Then you need to take an umbrella with you.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: True. The wind is strong too.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: And it's humid outside.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: Yes, I don't like this weather.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: I prefer sunny weather.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: Tomorrow the sun may be out.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.english: I hope so.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: See you tomorrow.

pair.english: Is it going to rain tomorrow?

response.english: Yes, take an umbrella with you.

lessons.culture: Fusha has two common words for the weather, الطَّقْسُ and الْجَوُّ, and both are what a forecaster says on the news. In everyday talk people use their own dialect, but a Fusha weather sentence is understood everywhere.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks: 'كَيْفَ الطَّقْسُ الْيَوْم؟'. Say it is very hot.
exercises.tip: الطَّقْسُ is 'the weather'; حَارٌّ is 'hot' and جِدًّا is 'very'.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'هَلْ سَتُمْطِرُ غَدًا؟'. Say you think so.
exercises.tip: أَظُنُّ ذَلِك is 'I think so'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الْجَوُّ _____ الْيَوْم.' (It's cold today.)
exercises.tip: بَارِدٌ is 'cold' and describes الْجَوُّ.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الشَّمْسُ _____ الْيَوْم.' (The sun's out today.)
exercises.tip: مُشْرِقَةٌ comes from أَشْرَقَتْ, 'it shone', and is feminine like الشَّمْس.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'It's cloudy.'
exercises.tip: غَائِم means 'cloudy'; غَيْم is 'clouds'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'You need to take an umbrella with you.' (to a man)
exercises.tip: يَجِبُ أَنْ means 'it is necessary that' and is followed by the present verb.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'It's raining outside.'?
exercises.tip: تُمْطِرُ comes from الْمَطَر, 'rain'.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'humid'?
exercises.tip: رَطْب means 'damp', and الرُّطُوبَة is 'humidity'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الْيَوْم / الطَّقْسُ / كَيْفَ'.
exercises.tip: كَيْفَ comes first, then the subject, then the time.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'غَدًا / سَتُمْطِرُ / هَلْ'.
exercises.tip: سَ before the verb makes it future: سَتُمْطِرُ, 'it will rain'.

phrases.arabic: فِي الشِّتَاءِ يَشْتَدُّ الْبَرْدُ كَثِيرًا فِي دِمَشْق
phrases.transliteration: fee ash-shitaa2i yashtaddu al-bardu katheeran fee Dimashq

phrases.arabic: فِي الْخَرِيفِ تَسْقُطُ الْأَوْرَاقُ مِنَ الْأَشْجَار
phrases.transliteration: fee al-khareefi tasqutu al-awraaqu mina al-ashjaar

phrases.arabic: لَا أُحِبُّ الشِّتَاءَ لِأَنَّ الْجَوَّ بَارِدٌ جِدًّا
phrases.transliteration: laa u7ibbu ash-shitaa2a li2anna al-jawwa baaridun jiddan

phrases.arabic: فِي الشِّتَاءِ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَلْبَسَ مَلَابِسَ ثَقِيلَة
phrases.transliteration: fee ash-shitaa2i yajibu an talbasa malaabisa thaqeela

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.english: What's your favorite season, Huda?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.english: Spring is my favorite season. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الصَّيْفَ، لَكِنَّ الصَّيْفَ فِي دِمَشْقَ طَوِيل.
dialogue.transliteration: anaa u7ibbu as-sayfa, lakinna as-sayfa fee Dimashqa taweel.
dialogue.english: I like summer, but summer in Damascus is long.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.english: Yes, and the weather is hot and dry.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.transliteration: wa fee ash-shitaa2i yashtaddu al-bardu katheeran.
dialogue.english: And in winter it gets very cold.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.english: That's why I don't like winter.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.english: Does it snow in Damascus?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.english: Sometimes, and it always snows on the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.english: And what about fall?

dialogue.speaker: Yusuf
dialogue.arabic: وَأَنَا أُحِبُّ رَائِحَةَ الْمَطَرِ فِي الرَّبِيع.
dialogue.transliteration: wa anaa u7ibbu raa2i7ata al-matari fee ar-rabee3.
dialogue.english: And I like the smell of rain in spring.

dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.english: So our favorite season is the same!

pair.english: What's the weather like in summer?

lessons.culture: Fusha names the four seasons الشِّتَاء, الرَّبِيع, الصَّيْف and الْخَرِيف, and the word فَصْل means both 'season' and 'chapter'. These are the words in school books and on forecasts, and every Arabic speaker knows them.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks you, a man: 'مَا فَصْلُكَ الْمُفَضَّل؟'. Say spring is your favorite.
exercises.tip: فَصْلِي is 'my season'; الْمُفَضَّل is 'the favorite'.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'لِمَاذَا لَا تُحِبُّ الشِّتَاء؟'. Say because it is very cold.
exercises.tip: لِأَنَّ means 'because' and is followed by a noun, here الْجَوَّ.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'فِي _____ تُثْلِجُ عَلَى الْجَبَل.' (In winter it snows on the mountain.)
exercises.tip: After فِي the noun takes a kasra: فِي الشِّتَاءِ.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'فِي الْخَرِيفِ تَسْقُطُ _____ مِنَ الْأَشْجَار.' (In fall the leaves fall from the trees.)
exercises.tip: الْأَوْرَاق is the plural of وَرَقَة, 'a leaf'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'Summer in Damascus is long.'
exercises.tip: No 'is' is needed: الصَّيْفُ طَوِيل is 'summer long'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'What season is it now?'
exercises.tip: Literally 'in which season are we now?'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'It's snowing on the mountain.'?
exercises.tip: الثَّلْج is 'snow', and تُثْلِجُ is 'it snows'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence says 'Spring is my favorite season'?
exercises.tip: الرَّبِيع is spring, الصَّيْف summer, الْخَرِيف fall, الشِّتَاء winter.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الْمُفَضَّل / فَصْلِي / الرَّبِيعُ'.
exercises.tip: The season comes first, then 'my favorite season'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الْأَوْرَاقُ / الْخَرِيفِ / فِي / تَسْقُطُ'.
exercises.tip: The season is named first, then what happens in it.

phrases.transliteration: fee as-sayfi albasu shortan wa qamees

phrases.arabic: تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى جَزْمَةٍ فِي الشِّتَاءِ لِأَنَّ الْمَطَرَ كَثِير
phrases.transliteration: ta7taaju ilaa jazmatin fee ash-shitaa2i li2anna al-matara katheer

phrases.arabic: مَا لَوْنُكَ الْمُفَضَّلُ فِي السُّتَرِ الصُّوفِيَّة؟
phrases.transliteration: maa lawnuka al-mufaddalu fee as-sutari as-soofiyya?

phrases.arabic: اِلْبَسْ شَيْئًا مُرِيحًا لِأَنَّنَا سَنَمْشِي كَثِيرًا
phrases.transliteration: ilbas shay2an muree7an li2annanaa sanamshee katheeran

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.english: What's the weather like outside?

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.english: It's cold and cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.english: And is it going to rain?

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.english: Yes, take an umbrella with you.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.arabic: لَقَدْ نَسِيتُ مِعْطَفَ الْمَطَرِ فِي الْبَيْت.
dialogue.transliteration: laqad naseetu mi3tafa al-matari fee al-bayt.
dialogue.english: I forgot the raincoat at home.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.english: No problem, the umbrella is enough.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.english: And what about shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى جَزْمَةٍ لِأَنَّ الشَّارِعَ مُبْتَلّ.
dialogue.transliteration: ta7taaju ilaa jazmatin li2anna ash-shaari3a mubtall.
dialogue.english: You need boots because the street is wet.

dialogue.speaker: Khalid
dialogue.english: Fine, I'll wear the boots.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.transliteration: wa laa tansa al-qubba3a, fal-bardu shadeed.
dialogue.english: And don't forget the hat, it's very cold.

pair.english: Is it going to rain today?

response.english: Yes, take an umbrella with you.

pair.english: Why are you wearing the hat?

response.english: Because it protects me from the sun.

lessons.culture: When someone asks what to wear, the answer in Fusha is a short command: اِلْبَسْ to a man and اِلْبَسِي to a woman. Advising a friend or a child about clothes for the weather is a common way to show care.

exercises.prompt: A friend says: 'مَاذَا أَلْبَسُ الْيَوْم؟'. It is cold. Advise a sweater.
exercises.tip: اِلْبَسْ is the command 'wear' to a man.

exercises.prompt: A man says: 'سَتُمْطِرُ الْيَوْم'. Tell him to take an umbrella.
exercises.tip: خُذْ is the command 'take' and مَعَكَ is 'with you'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'فِي الصَّيْفِ أَلْبَسُ شُورْتًا وَ_____.' (In summer I wear shorts and a shirt.)
exercises.tip: قَمِيص is a shirt.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'ضَعْ _____ شَمْسِيَّةً، فَالشَّمْسُ قَوِيَّة.' (Put on your sunglasses, the sun is strong.)
exercises.tip: نَظَّارَةٌ شَمْسِيَّة is 'sun glasses'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'What should I wear today?'
exercises.tip: مَاذَا is 'what' before a verb.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'I forgot the raincoat at home.'
exercises.tip: مِعْطَفُ الْمَطَر is 'the coat of rain', a raincoat.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'Put on your sunglasses, the sun is strong'?
exercises.tip: فَ here means 'because' and links the reason.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'boots'?
exercises.tip: قُبَّعَة is a hat and سُتْرَة a jacket or sweater.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'مَعَكَ / مِظَلَّةً / خُذْ'.
exercises.tip: The command comes first.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الشَّمْس / مِنَ / تَحْمِيكَ / الْقُبَّعَةُ'.
exercises.tip: حَمَى مِنْ means 'protect from'.

phrases.arabic: إِذَا كَانَ الْجَوُّ جَمِيلًا سَنَخْرُجُ إِلَى الْحَدِيقَة
phrases.transliteration: idhaa kaana al-jawwu jameelan sanakhruju ilaa al-7adeeqa

phrases.arabic: الْجَوُّ لَيْسَ جَيِّدًا، يَجِبُ أَنْ نُلْغِيَ النُّزْهَة
phrases.transliteration: al-jawwu laysa jayyidan, yajibu an nulghiya an-nuzha

phrases.arabic: مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ الْيَوْم؟
phrases.transliteration: maa ra2yuka an nabqaa fee al-bayti al-yawm?

phrases.arabic: لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ الْخُرُوجَ، الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا
سَنَجْلِسُ عَلَى الشُّرْفَةِ اللَّيْلَةَ، الْجَوُّ لَطِيف
بِمَا أَنَّهَا سَتُمْطِرُ، لِنُؤَجِّلْ سَهْرَةَ الْمَسَاء
phrases.transliteration: bimaa annahaa satumtiru, linu2ajjil sahrata al-masaa2

phrases.arabic: الطَّقْسُ لَا يَسْمَحُ لَنَا بِاللَّعِبِ فِي الْخَارِج
phrases.transliteration: at-taqsu laa yasma7u lanaa bil-la3ibi fee al-khaarij

phrases.arabic: مَا دَامَ الْجَوُّ جَمِيلًا سَنَسْتَمِرُّ فِي الْخُرُوج
phrases.transliteration: maa daama al-jawwu jameelan sanastamirru fee al-khurooj

phrases.arabic: الرِّحْلَةُ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ تَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الطَّقْس

reply.english: Yes, it's going to rain tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.english: Did you see the weather forecast?

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.arabic: إِذَنْ مَا رَأْيُكِ أَنْ نُؤَجِّلَ الرِّحْلَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: idhan maa ra2yuki an nu2ajjila ar-ri7la?
dialogue.english: Then what do you think about postponing the trip?

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.english: True. If it rains tomorrow we'll postpone it.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: And what about today? The weather is nice.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.english: Let's go out for a walk in the park.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَة. مَا دَامَ الْجَوُّ جَمِيلًا سَنَسْتَمِرُّ فِي الْخُرُوج.
dialogue.transliteration: fikratun jayyida. maa daama al-jawwu jameelan sanastamirru fee al-khurooj.
dialogue.english: Good idea. As long as the weather is good we'll keep going out.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.english: And tonight we'll sit on the balcony.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: Yes, the weather is pleasant in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: Ziad
dialogue.transliteration: wa in amtarat, nabqaa fee al-bayt.
dialogue.english: And if it rains, we stay home.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: Agreed.

pair.english: Did you see the weather forecast?

response.english: Yes, it's going to rain tomorrow.

pair.arabic: مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْت؟
pair.transliteration: maa ra2yuka an nabqaa fee al-bayt?
pair.english: What do you think about staying home?

response.english: If the weather's nice, we'll go out.

lessons.culture: Fusha plans use إِذَا, 'if', followed by a past-tense verb, and then the future with سَ. نَشْرَةُ الْأَحْوَالِ الْجَوِّيَّة, 'the bulletin of weather conditions', is what news programmes call the forecast.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'هَلْ شَاهَدْتَ نَشْرَةَ الْأَحْوَالِ الْجَوِّيَّة؟'. Say yes, it will rain tomorrow.
exercises.tip: سَتُمْطِرُ is 'it will rain'.

exercises.prompt: Someone says: 'مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ الْيَوْم؟'. Agree.
exercises.tip: فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَة is 'a good idea'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: '_____ أَمْطَرَتْ غَدًا سَنُؤَجِّلُ الرِّحْلَة.' (If it rains tomorrow we'll postpone the trip.)
exercises.tip: إِذَا is 'if' and takes a past-tense verb.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'الطَّقْسُ لَا _____ لَنَا بِاللَّعِبِ فِي الْخَارِج.' (The weather doesn't allow us to play outside.)
exercises.tip: سَمَحَ لَـ means 'allow'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'Did you see the weather forecast?' (to a man)
exercises.tip: شَاهَدْتَ is 'you saw' to a man; to a woman it is شَاهَدْتِ.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'I can't go out, it's too hot.'
exercises.answer: لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ الْخُرُوجَ، الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا
accepted: لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ الْخُرُوجَ، الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا
لا استطيع الخروج، الجو حار جدا
لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ، الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا

too_formal.item: مَا فِيِّي إِطْلَع، الْجَوّ حَرّ كْتِير

exercises.tip: لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ is 'I cannot', followed by a verbal noun such as الْخُرُوج.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'The trip depends on the weather'?
exercises.tip: اِعْتَمَدَ عَلَى means 'depend on'.

exercises.prompt: Which verb means 'we postpone'?
exercises.tip: أَجَّلَ is 'he postponed'; نَخْرُجُ is 'we go out'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الرِّحْلَةَ / غَدًا / سَنُؤَجِّلُ / أَمْطَرَتْ / إِذَا'.

too_formal.item: لَوْ شَتَّتْ بُكْرَا رَح نْأَجِّل الرِّحْلَة

exercises.tip: The condition comes first, then the result.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'نَبْقَى / أَنْ / فِي / رَأْيُكَ / مَا / الْبَيْت'.
exercises.answer: مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْت
accepted: مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْت
ما رايك ان نبقى في البيت
maa ra2yuka an nabqaa fee al-bayt
مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ
exercises.tip: مَا رَأْيُكَ is 'what is your opinion'.

phrases.arabic: اِبْقَ فِي الْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَمُرَّ الْعَاصِفَة

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.arabic: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى السَّمَاء، إِنَّهَا مُلَبَّدَةٌ بِالْغُيُوم.
dialogue.transliteration: unzur ilaa as-samaa', innahaa mulabbadatun bil-ghuyoom.
dialogue.english: Look at the sky, it is covered with clouds.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, wa hunaaka barqun wa ra3dun aydan.
dialogue.english: Yes, and there is lightning and thunder too.

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: I heard the storm is strong tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Are you going out now?

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.arabic: لَا، سَأَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَمُرَّ الْعَاصِفَة.
dialogue.transliteration: laa, sa-abqaa fee al-bayti 7attaa tamurra al-3aasifa.
dialogue.english: No, I'll stay home until the storm passes.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Wise choice. Yesterday I got soaked by the rain.

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: And did water flood the street at your place?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, wa inqata3ati al-kahrabaa'u bisababi al-3aasifa.
dialogue.english: Yes, and the electricity was cut because of the storm.

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.arabic: لَا قَدَّرَ اللَّه. هَلْ عَادَتِ الْكَهْرَبَاءُ الْآن؟
dialogue.transliteration: laa qaddara allaah. hal 3aadati al-kahrabaa'u al-aan?
dialogue.english: May Allah forbid. Has the electricity come back now?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Yes, and the rain stopped for a little while.

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: Be careful, the road is slippery after the rain.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: شُكْرًا. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى هَذَا الْمَطَر.
dialogue.english: Thanks. Thank Allah for this rain.

response.english: I got soaked by the rain.

pair.english: Be careful, the road is slippery.

lessons.culture: Rain is welcomed in much of the Arab world as a mercy, so people often say الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى هَذَا الْمَطَر when it falls. Fusha uses غَزِير for heavy rain and عَاصِفَة for a storm, words heard in every news bulletin. لَا قَدَّرَ اللَّه, 'may Allah not decree it', is said after bad news to wish that it does not happen.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'هَلْ سَتَخْرُجُ الْآن؟' Say no, you will stay home until the storm passes.
exercises.answer: لَا، سَأَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَمُرَّ الْعَاصِفَة
accepted: لَا، سَأَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَمُرَّ الْعَاصِفَة
لا، سابقى في البيت حتى تمر العاصفة
laa, sa-abqaa fee al-bayti 7attaa tamurra al-3aasifa
exercises.tip: حَتَّى means 'until'.

exercises.prompt: Someone says: 'الطَّرِيقُ زَلِقٌ بَعْدَ الْمَطَر.' Thank him and say you will be careful.
exercises.tip: اِنْتَبَهَ means 'be careful'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'السَّمَاءُ _____ بِالْغُيُوم.' (The sky is covered with clouds.)
exercises.tip: سَمَاء is feminine, so the adjective ends in ة.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'اِنْقَطَعَتِ _____ بِسَبَبِ الْعَاصِفَة.' (The electricity was cut because of the storm.)
exercises.tip: كَهْرَبَاء is 'electricity'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'There is lightning and thunder.'
exercises.tip: بَرْق is lightning and رَعْد is thunder.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'The rain stopped.'
exercises.tip: تَوَقَّفَ is 'stopped'.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'lightning'?
exercises.tip: رَعْد is thunder, the sound that follows.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'The storm is strong tonight'?
exercises.tip: عَاصِفَة is 'storm'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الْعَاصِفَةُ / اللَّيْلَة / قَوِيَّةٌ'.
exercises.tip: Subject first, then the description, then the time.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'غَزِيرٌ / الْيَوْم / الْمَطَرُ'.
exercises.tip: Name the rain first, then say it is heavy.

phrases.arabic: أَنْظُرُ إِلَى حَالَةِ الطَّقْسِ فِي الْهَاتِف
سَيَكُونُ الْجَوُّ غَائِمًا مَعَ أَمْطَارٍ خَفِيفَة
phrases.transliteration: sayakoonu al-jawwu ghaa'iman ma3a amtaarin khafeefa

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: And will it be sunny?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، طَوَالَ الْأُسْبُوع. لَكِنْ يُتَوَقَّعُ هُطُولُ أَمْطَارٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَة.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, tawaala al-usboo3. lakin yutawaqqa3u hutoolu amtaarin yawma al-jum3a.
dialogue.english: Yes, all week. But rain is expected on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: How do you know that?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Not always, but they are useful.

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: And what about the night?

dialogue.speaker: Yazan
dialogue.english: Then I'll take a jacket with me.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: And listen to the news bulletin in the morning.

lessons.culture: News bulletins in Fusha give the forecast in fixed words such as يُتَوَقَّعُ, 'it is expected', and دَرَجَاتُ الْحَرَارَة, 'degrees of heat'. Temperatures in the Arab world are given in Celsius. Because these words are the same on every Arab channel, learning them lets you follow a forecast from Morocco to Iraq.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks: 'مَا دَرَجَةُ الْحَرَارَةِ غَدًا؟' Say thirty degrees.
exercises.tip: ثَلَاثُونَ is thirty.

exercises.prompt: Someone asks: 'هَلِ التَّوَقُّعَاتُ دَقِيقَةٌ دَائِمًا؟' Say not always.
exercises.tip: لَيْسَتْ is the feminine 'is not', because التَّوَقُّعَات is a plural thing.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'يُتَوَقَّعُ _____ أَمْطَارٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَة.' (Rain is expected on Friday.)
exercises.tip: هُطُول means 'falling' of rain.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'سَتَنْخَفِضُ دَرَجَاتُ _____ فِي اللَّيْل.' (The temperature will drop at night.)
exercises.tip: دَرَجَاتُ الْحَرَارَة is 'degrees of heat'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'What's the temperature tomorrow?'
exercises.tip: دَرَجَة is 'degree'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'The weather will be better tomorrow.'
exercises.tip: أَفْضَل means 'better'.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'degree'?
exercises.tip: دَرَجَة is also a step on a staircase.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means 'The weather will be cloudy with light rain'?
options: سَيَكُونُ الْجَوُّ غَائِمًا مَعَ أَمْطَارٍ خَفِيفَة
exercises.answer: سَيَكُونُ الْجَوُّ غَائِمًا مَعَ أَمْطَارٍ خَفِيفَة
accepted: سَيَكُونُ الْجَوُّ غَائِمًا مَعَ أَمْطَارٍ خَفِيفَة
سيكون الجو غائما مع امطار خفيفة
sayakoonu al-jawwu ghaa'iman ma3a amtaarin khafeefa
exercises.tip: غَائِم is 'cloudy' and خَفِيف is 'light'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'غَدًا / الْحَرَارَةِ / دَرَجَةُ / مَا'.
exercises.tip: The question word مَا comes first.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الْأُسْبُوع / مُشْمِسًا / سَيَكُونُ / طَوَالَ / الْجَوُّ'.
exercises.tip: طَوَالَ means 'throughout'.

challenge.title: Plan a day around the weather
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation in Fusha between two friends. They ask about the weather and the season, say what they like and dislike, advise each other what to wear, and make or postpone a plan depending on the forecast.
required_elements: a question about the weather and its answer
advice about what to wear or take
a plan that depends on the weather with إِذَا
a plan that is postponed or changed

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: How is the weather today?

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.english: The weather is nice and the sun is out.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: What's your favorite season?

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.arabic: الرَّبِيعُ فَصْلِي الْمُفَضَّل، لِأَنَّ الْجَوَّ لَطِيف.
dialogue.transliteration: ar-rabee3u faslee al-mufaddal, li2anna al-jawwa lateef.
dialogue.english: Spring is my favorite season, because the weather is pleasant.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: Let's go out for a walk in the park.

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.arabic: فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَة. هَلْ شَاهَدْتَ نَشْرَةَ الْأَحْوَالِ الْجَوِّيَّة؟
dialogue.transliteration: fikratun jayyida. hal shaahadta nashrata al-a7waali al-jawwiyya?
dialogue.english: Good idea. Did you see the weather forecast?

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، سَتُمْطِرُ غَدًا. يَجِبُ أَنْ تَأْخُذِي مِظَلَّةً مَعَكِ.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, satumtiru ghadan. yajibu an ta2khudhee mizallatan ma3aki.
dialogue.english: Yes, it's going to rain tomorrow. You need to take an umbrella with you.

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.english: If it rains tomorrow we'll postpone the trip.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: Agreed. And tonight we'll sit on the balcony.

dialogue.speaker: Rana
dialogue.arabic: نَعَمْ، لَكِنِ اِلْبَسْ سُتْرَةً، فَالْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ فِي اللَّيْل.
dialogue.transliteration: na3am, lakini ilbas sutratan, fal-jawwu baaridun fee al-layl.
dialogue.english: Yes, but wear a jacket, it's cold at night.
